entities.summary: Marcos José Carvajal was a Venezuelan professional baseball relief pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Colorado Rockies and Florida Marlins. Listed at 6' 4", (1.93 m), 175 lb. (79 k), Carvajal batted and threw right-handed.
